value: **Involvement**: Teachers partnered with researchers in an iterative collaborative design process to conceptualize, author, and contextualize curricular materials and learning activities tailored to their classroom environments. **Evidence**: "Consider a district professional development (PD) director working with a researcher to codesign a new PD program. The main problem here lies in the challenge to meet the needs of many teachers while providing engaging PD that will be enacted in the classroom."
